name: Commonwealth Online
author: kkblparker@gmail.com
description: Commonwealth Online dedicated relay server (Python). Installs the server/ directory from the Commonwealth-Online-Server repository and runs it via start.sh, which manages its own virtualenv. Game traffic is TCP on the primary allocation.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Commonwealth Online Server - install / update script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
# Clones the repository and copies the Python dedicated server (server/)
# into the container. Re-running the installer updates the code while
# keeping commonwealth-server.json, bans.json, logs and the .venv.

set -e

GIT_ADDRESS="${GIT_ADDRESS:-https://git.zambazosmedia.group/Commonwealth-Online/Commonwealth-Online-Server.git}"

if ! command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git ca-certificates
fi

if [[ -n "${USERNAME}" && -n "${ACCESS_TOKEN}" ]]; then
    GIT_ADDRESS="$(echo "${GIT_ADDRESS}" | sed -E "s#^https://#https://${USERNAME}:${ACCESS_TOKEN}@#")"
fi

rm -rf /tmp/cwo-src
echo "Cloning repository${BRANCH:+ (branch ${BRANCH})}..."
if [[ -n "${BRANCH}" ]]; then
    git clone --depth 1 --branch "${BRANCH}" "${GIT_ADDRESS}" /tmp/cwo-src
else
    git clone --depth 1 "${GIT_ADDRESS}" /tmp/cwo-src
fi

if [[ ! -f /tmp/cwo-src/server/consumer_server_cli.py ]]; then
    echo "ERROR: server/consumer_server_cli.py not found in repository."
    exit 1
fi

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

# Preserve operator state across reinstalls.
mkdir -p /tmp/cwo-keep
for f in commonwealth-server.json bans.json; do
    [[ -f "$f" ]] && cp -a "$f" /tmp/cwo-keep/
done

cp -a /tmp/cwo-src/server/. /mnt/server/

for f in commonwealth-server.json bans.json; do
    [[ -f "/tmp/cwo-keep/$f" ]] && cp -a "/tmp/cwo-keep/$f" "/mnt/server/$f"
done

# Normalise line endings / executable bits in case of CRLF checkouts.
sed -i 's/\r$//' start.sh fix-port.sh 2>/dev/null || true
chmod +x start.sh fix-port.sh 2>/dev/null || true

(cd /tmp/cwo-src && git rev-parse --short HEAD) > /mnt/server/.installed-commit || true
rm -rf /tmp/cwo-src /tmp/cwo-keep

echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Commonwealth Online Server installed ($(cat /mnt/server/.installed-commit 2>/dev/null))"
echo "Python dependencies are installed into .venv on first start."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.description: Repository to install the server from. Reinstall the server to pull updates.

variables.description: Branch to install. Leave empty for the default branch.

variables.description: Username for a private repository. Leave empty if public.
